1.Name: Cold Flame Candle
1.Des: Cold flame candle produced in Lira. With inheritable grass fields perfect for cattle, Lira residents produce candles with the oil from cattle, and manage to cool the flames down with special techniques, ensuring the light provided while preventing potential fire hazards.

2.Name: Short-tail Veal Steak
2.Des: Seasoned beef produced in Lira. With inheritable grass fields perfect for cattle, this town yields plenty of Short-tail Veal Steaks. The seasoning techniques add not only to the flavor but also to shelf life, enabling transportation and sales to further places.

3.Name: Little Laela Perfume
3.Des: Rich perfume produced in Lira. Little Laela, the main ingredient, is a herb growing on the sunny sides in the dense woods. The petals taste somehow sweet and are edible. Often found in scented tea, the flower is also widely used in perfumes when condensed.

4.Name: Fossilized Dragon Bone
4.Des: Fossilized dragon bone unique to Springs Town. Thousands of years ago, Dragons might have resided inside the extinct volcano nearby. The rare fossils remained thereafter.

5.Name: Refined Sulfur
5.Des: Refined sulfur produced in Springs Town. After the eruption hundreds of years ago, the extinct volcano near Springs Town left some high-quality sulfur deposits behind. Alchemists love them for they are easy to be refined.

6.Name: Silk
6.Des: Silk unique to Harmony City made from top-quality silk threads. Due to the limited yield and complicated production processes, each piece is valuable.

7.Name: Sachet
7.Des: Sachet unique to Harmony City. Made from the delicate silk produced in the local area and decorated with the embroidery of skilled professionals, it is special and valuable as an accessory.

8.Name: Femme Fatale Antidote
8.Des: Precious medicine produced in Snowy Peaks neutralises all kinds of hallucinogenic toxins. Femme Fatale, the main ingredient, is a special-scented flower feeding on insects, with its spiky toxic tentacles in the center. The juicy white petals can be extracted for hallucinogen antidote.

9.Name: Dawn Coral Fungi
9.Des: Delicious mushroom produced in Snowy Peaks, named after its color similar to the sky at dawn, as well as its shape resembling the coral in the sea. Often found near the roots of tall trees, it tastes tender and is loved by customers.

10.Name: Limestone Ore
10.Des: Ore produced in Ore Valley. Getting the lime color from the high-quality copper inside, it is widely used in the production industry. You might even find some stunning malachite inside.

11.Name: Ruby Ore
11.Des: Ore produced in Ore Valley. Getting the crimson color from the high-quality iron inside, it is widely used in the production industry. You might even find some stunning pyrite inside.

12.Name: Sage blueberry
12.Des: A common bush yields lots of fruits, which taste a little bit sour. Eat them raw or cook them as you wish.

13.Name: Goldarrow Berry
13.Des: A precious herb yielding bright-colored fruits. They are tender, juicy, and rich in flavor. However, they are also vulnerable, thus expensive.

14.Name: Mithril Helmet
14.Des: One of the bestsellers of the Foundry. A helmet made with a certain amount of Mithril. Light, tough, and economic, it is the most purchased in its kind, chosen by both mid-level officers and common mercenaries.

15.Name: Tastan Gold Ring
15.Des: One of the bestsellers of the Foundry. A delicate ring made from Tastan gold generally loved due to the personalization feature.

16.Name: Starry Night Blue Lobster
16.Des: Rare saltwater lobster, and valuable ingredients as well. Myth says that this lobster can only be caught in the clear, blue ocean under the star-lit sky. The truth is, the name draws from the spots upon its dark blue carapace.

999.Name: Bag
999.Des: Rowan's backpack. Increases your cart storage by a compartment.
